features.name: x1_scaled
features.description: Standardized version of x1 to provide a smooth normalized score for linear SVM margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves convergence and margin scaling for linear models by centering and scaling the feature.

features.name: x2_scaled
features.description: Standardized version of x2 using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures x2 contributes proportionally to the SVM decision boundary without dominating due to its scale.

features.name: x6_scaled
features.description: Standardized version of x6 to align its variance with other numeric features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the relatively large variance of x6 from disproportionately influencing the linear projection.

features.name: x9_scaled
features.description: Standardized version of x9 to bring its large magnitude into a normalized range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Crucial for SVMs to handle features with naturally large magnitudes like x9 smoothly.

features.name: x9_x10_ratio_centered
features.description: The ratio of x9 to x10, centered around its approximate mean to provide a continuous severity measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative interaction between x9 and x10 in a single linear-friendly dimension.

features.name: x2_x4_composite
features.description: A weighted composite of standardized x2 and x4 to capture their combined linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a pre-computed linear combination that can help the SVM find a more robust margin.

features.name: x1_x5_cross
features.description: Cross-product of standardized x1 and x5 to introduce a non-linear interaction as a linear feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear SVM to leverage the multiplicative interaction between x1 and x5.

features.name: x7_yes_indicator
features.description: Bipolar indicator for x7 being 'yes', mapped to 1.0 and -1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bipolar encoding is optimal for SVM margins, centering the categorical effect around zero.

features.name: x8_large_indicator
features.description: Bipolar indicator for x8 being 'large', mapped to 1.0 and -1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a symmetric, zero-centered feature for the SVM to weight the 'large' category.

features.name: x3_brown_indicator
features.description: Bipolar indicator for the most frequent category 'brown' in x3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights the dominant category in x3 using a margin-friendly bipolar scale.

features.name: semantic_anomaly_score
features.description: Evaluates how anomalous the combination of categorical variables (x3, x7, x8) is relative to the typical profile observed in the training data.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of categorical rarity, which can be linearly weighted by the SVM.

features.name: semantic_magnitude_index
features.description: Assesses the overall magnitude and extremity of the numeric features (x1, x2, x4, x6) considering their typical ranges and standard deviations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes multiple numeric dimensions into a single continuous index, simplifying the linear projection space.
